LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.4 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Chinese characters (strokes and stroke o
Topic 3.5: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.4 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Chinese characters (strokes and stroke o in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What role does handwriting play in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio clip and list the names of sports and games (足球 zúqiú、篮球 lánqiú、网球 wǎngqiú、乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú、 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú),

2. create bingo cards with images or names of different sports in Chinese by calling out the names of the sports, and allowing their peers to mark the corresponding sport on their cards,

3. decide if the order of the sentences given is correct or incorrect with peers,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio clip and list the names of sports and games (足球 zúqiú、篮球 lánqiú、网球 wǎngqiú、乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú、 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú),
2. create bingo cards with images or names of different sports in Chinese by calling out the names of the sports, and allowing their peers to mark the corresponding sport on their cards,
3. decide if the order of the sentences given is correct or incorrect with peers,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: Teamwork skills are developed as the learner works collaboratively in creating and playing

the bingo word game with others.

Values:
Respect: The learner appreciates the diverse opinions of their peers as they discuss the importance of engaging in varied sports

and games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer pressure resistance: This skill is developed as the learner justifies why engaging in their preferred sports and games is

important.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Creative Arts on the concept of developing social skills through engaging in sports and games.
